selection.criteria: step=0, not done/failure, finite, URDF bounds (1e-7 float tolerance), target_before=qpos within 1e-5, max marginal z<=3, abs(index MCP_AA)<=0.18rad and pinky MCP_FE<=1.4rad after failed physical initializations, pairwise joint RMS>=0.15rad; one reproducible random row from each of shards 75/317/589; no grasp/orientation filter
selection.dataset_identity_note: 本地数据集；与checkpoint原训练目录的完全等价性未核实。

limitations: 历史基线，非同一时刻配对重跑；每个初始化仅一轮；真机测量/时序存在差异。初始化选择受可到位筛选影响。
